blurb: When you come play The Wetlands Golf Course, you will experience some of the best golf in Lafayette. Our Lafayette golf course is 18-holes and is perfect for all levels of golfers to be challenged while having a blast. Our wide open fairways and subtle rolling terrain will let you step away from life for a little while and focus on your golf passion.
